designIntent: 主形象D的呆萌Q版分身，适合作为主Agent陪伴角色与状态反馈形象。
features: 青蓝眼睛与一颗小虎牙
原设可可棕外侧、奶油白耳尖的折耳犬耳
复用08樱桃黑舞台服的颜色与结构
prompt: Create the official Q-version companion of the same original D puppy-girl. Preserve pink flowing hair, side braid, bent ahoge, teal-blue eyes, goofy smile with one tiny fang, square hairclip, folded dog ears with original cocoa-brown outer fur and cream tips/inner fur. Reinterpret selected cherry-black stage costume faithfully at chibi scale: charcoal cropped jacket, cherry satin details, cream ruffled blouse, layered skirt, waist ribbon and boots. 2.5-head-tall proportions, full body, transparent background, polished dimensional anime mascot illustration. No text, logo, frame, props, extra characters or added animal features.
